# Code of Conduct

This project adopts the **Contributor Covenant, version 2.1**, in full. The
canonical text lives at:

https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/

A summary, in plain language: be kind, be respectful, give people the
benefit of the doubt, focus on the technical work. The full Covenant text
linked above is the binding document — please read it before contributing.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all project spaces — issues, pull requests,
discussions, the live demo, the Discord channel, and any public space where
someone is representing the project.

## Reporting

If you observe behavior that violates this Code of Conduct, contact the
maintainer privately:

- Open a private GitHub Security Advisory at
  https://github.com/StbanMc/seasonly/security/advisories/new
- Or send a message to `stbanmc@users.noreply.github.com`

Reports are read by the maintainer (Esteban Esquivel) and treated
confidentially. Reasonable response time on a volunteer-maintained
project is "within 7 days, best effort". Serious or ongoing situations
get faster acknowledgement.

## Enforcement

The maintainer follows the **Contributor Covenant Enforcement Guidelines**,
which describe a four-step ladder from a private warning through a
permanent ban for repeat or severe violations. The full guidelines:

https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
